The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. W. G. I. M. Amarasinghe who worked as a Sales Representative of Metro Aut. Mart (Pvt) Ltd is entitled for, - Commissions and telephone charges for ther period from January 2017 to February 2018, - Vehicle allowance for the two months of August and September 2017, and - The commission of 1% deducted from the commission by the establishment during his period of service.
and if so, to what relief he is entitled for the injustice caused by not receiving them.
